dedupe_keys.name: a database seed for a community driven material intensity research platform

description: A database seed for a community-driven material intensity research platform is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Niko Heeren et al. The data record contains Material Intensity data for buildings (MI). MI coefficients are often used for different types of analysis of socio-economic systems and in particular for environmental assessments. Until now, MI values were compiled and reported ad-hoc with few cross-study comparisons. Coverage: not stated; published in 2019. Formats: CSV, Image, PDF. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
